- **`origin/legacy/reporting`** — sounds like an intentionally-kept legacy branch, not an old default.
- No README/CI/config files in the repo reference any of these names, so I can't confirm from context.

Which branch was the old default name you want deleted from `origin`? If it's `production`, note that its `790d05e "wrong branch"` commit is only preserved elsewhere via `legacy/reporting` — worth confirming that's intentional before I delete it.
